searchText: What is the easiest way of extending Solidity with new opcodes? We need this to enable `BEACONBLOCKROOT` and probably some other opcodes to be able to create contracts that read beacon state in executable beacon chain setup. cc <@!689161464829050960> actually looks like it was <@!415548822983278593> who implemented the experimental op `PAYGAS` , here is the diff if it helps: https://github.com/ethereum/solidity/compare/develop...quilt:account-abstraction thanks a lot!
